purpose: Create the model-agnostic daily 2 m thermal state legally available at a specified forecast issue time.

parameters.minimum_hours: default 18 distinct valid hourly observations per UTC day

failure_conditions: unknown data availability in data_available_time mode
scientific_assumptions: target is Windermere South Basin 2 m water temperature
historical proxy mode uses observation_time as an explicitly labelled availability proxy
no imputation or model-specific features are added
future observation times are never used
